newsitem.title: USA: Vitafort hires Jack Spencer as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Vitafort hires Jack Spencer as CFO.

text.p: Food marketer Vitafort International Corp said Wednesday it had hired Jack Spencer as chief operating officer and chief financial officer.
Spencer will replace Eloy Ellis as chief financial officer, a company official later said.

Vitafort also said in its statement that Spencer had been involved in the restructuring and recapitalization of more than 20 companies. He had previously served as chief operating officer of Resdel Industries, it added.
Vitafort markets a proprietary line of low fat and fat free food products including toaster pastries, brownies, snack cakes, cookies, boxed chocolates and sundry healthy snack foods.
